name: claude-skills
description: Yuri Mikhin's Claude Code skills. Each one installs on its own.

plugins.name: mikhin-cx
plugins.description: Cross-model review of a diff, commit or plan through the Codex CLI. Codex reads, Claude judges.

plugins.name: mikhin-consensus
plugins.description: Adversarial multi-agent debate: roles get mutually exclusive hypotheses and must refute each other, exit on agreement.

plugins.name: mikhin-multi-agent-research
plugins.description: Four parallel sub-agents research a topic from different angles, synthesised into one report.

plugins.name: mikhin-all-check
plugins.description: Run every check the project has except e2e, scoped to the files of the current PR, one line per check.

plugins.name: mikhin-decisions
plugins.description: How Yuri Mikhin decides: answer the why, look it up before inventing it, fix the class not the call site. Autoloads into every session.

plugins.name: mikhin-review
plugins.description: How Yuri Mikhin wants bugs and findings handled: why didn't the tests catch it, failing test before fix, anchored findings, per-item verdicts.

plugins.name: mikhin-comms
plugins.description: How Yuri Mikhin writes to people: draft first, no blame, no hinted defects, one question instead of a pile of comments.

plugins.name: mikhin-stack
plugins.description: What Yuri Mikhin already knows and how work gets verified: the checking stack, viewport review, the product side of his own plugins and bots. Autoloads into every session.
